scenarios.name: Empty name is rejected on submit
scenarios.oracle: name field requires at least 1 character — z.string().min(1, 'Name is required')
verify: submission should be blocked
error message 'Name is required' should appear on the name field
no network request should be sent

scenarios.name: Single character name is accepted
scenarios.oracle: min(1) boundary — a single character is the minimum valid name
verify: submission should proceed
no validation error on name field
payload name should be 'A'

scenarios.name: Name at varchar(255) limit is accepted
scenarios.oracle: DB column is varchar(255) — a 255-character name should be the maximum valid value
verify: Zod parse should succeed
payload name should be exactly 255 characters

scenarios.name: Name exceeding varchar(255) causes a DB error (Zod gap)
scenarios.oracle: DB column is varchar(255) — Zod has no .max(255), so a 256-char name passes Zod but fails at DB. This is a validation gap: Zod SHOULD reject it with a friendly error.
verify: Zod parse should succeed (current behavior — this is the gap)
API should return an error from DB (raw Postgres error, not user-friendly)
EXPECTED FIX: Zod should reject with 'Name must be 255 characters or fewer'

scenarios.name: SKU exceeding varchar(50) causes a DB error (Zod gap)
scenarios.oracle: DB column is varchar(50) — Zod has no .max(50), so a 51-char SKU passes Zod but fails at DB. This is a validation gap.
verify: Zod parse should succeed (current behavior — gap)
API should return a DB error
EXPECTED FIX: Zod should reject with 'SKU must be 50 characters or fewer'

scenarios.name: SKU at varchar(50) limit is accepted
scenarios.oracle: DB column is varchar(50) — 50 characters is the boundary for acceptance
verify: Zod parse should succeed
payload sku should be exactly 50 characters

scenarios.name: Category exceeding varchar(100) causes a DB error (Zod gap)
scenarios.oracle: DB column is varchar(100) — Zod has no .max(100), so a 101-char category passes Zod but fails at DB.
verify: Zod parse should succeed (current behavior — gap)
API should return a DB error
EXPECTED FIX: Zod should reject with 'Category must be 100 characters or fewer'

scenarios.name: Negative stock value is rejected
scenarios.oracle: stock has z.string().refine(non-negative) — '-1' must be rejected
verify: submission should be blocked
error message 'Must be a non-negative number' should appear on stock field
no network request should be sent

scenarios.name: Zero stock is accepted (boundary)
scenarios.oracle: stock refine checks n >= 0 — '0' is the boundary, must be accepted
verify: Zod parse should succeed
payload stock should be '0'
no validation error on stock field

scenarios.name: Non-numeric stock value is rejected
scenarios.oracle: stock refine checks !isNaN(Number(v)) — 'abc' must be rejected
verify: submission should be blocked
error message 'Must be a non-negative number' should appear on stock field

scenarios.name: Non-numeric safety stock passes Zod (validation gap vs stock symmetry)
scenarios.oracle: safetyStock uses z.string().transform(empty->'0') but has NO numeric validation. 'abc' passes Zod but will fail at DB with numeric(12,4). This is asymmetric with stock which DOES validate.
verify: Zod parse should succeed (current behavior — gap)
payload safetyStock should be 'abc'
API should return a raw DB error
EXPECTED FIX: safetyStock should have the same refine(non-negative number) as stock

scenarios.name: Empty safety stock transforms to '0'
scenarios.oracle: safetyStock transform converts empty string to '0'
verify: Zod parse should succeed
payload safetyStock should be '0'

scenarios.name: Non-numeric purchase price passes Zod (validation gap)
scenarios.oracle: defaultPurchasePrice uses nullableString (trim + empty->null) but has NO numeric validation. 'not-a-number' passes Zod but will fail at DB with numeric(10,4).
verify: Zod parse should succeed (current behavior — gap)
payload defaultPurchasePrice should be 'not-a-number'
API should return a raw DB error
EXPECTED FIX: Zod should validate numeric format

scenarios.name: Non-numeric selling price passes Zod (validation gap, symmetric with purchase price)
scenarios.oracle: defaultSellingPrice uses nullableString — same gap as defaultPurchasePrice. Both price fields should be validated identically.
verify: Zod parse should succeed (current behavior — gap)
payload defaultSellingPrice should be 'xyz'
API should return a raw DB error
EXPECTED FIX: Zod should validate numeric format, same rule as purchase price

scenarios.name: Empty purchase price normalizes to null
scenarios.oracle: nullableString transforms empty/whitespace strings to null — empty price should become null in payload
verify: Zod parse should succeed
payload defaultPurchasePrice should be null

scenarios.name: Unit selection is required when creating an item
scenarios.oracle: unitDefinitionId has z.string().min(1, 'Unit is required') on insert schema
verify: submission should be blocked
error message 'Unit is required' should appear on unit field
no network request should be sent

scenarios.name: Unit field is omitted from update schema (immutable after creation)
scenarios.oracle: updateItemSchema omits unitDefinitionId — the field should not appear in the edit form payload
actions: open edit form for existing item
verify: payload should NOT contain unitDefinitionId
unit should be displayed as read-only text, not a select

scenarios.name: BOM quantity is required when bomMode is 'quantity'
scenarios.oracle: bomRefine checks: if bomMode='quantity' and !row.quantity, issue error 'Quantity is required'
verify: submission should be blocked
error message 'Quantity is required' should appear on the quantity field of the BOM row

scenarios.name: BOM percentage is required when bomMode is 'percentage'
scenarios.oracle: bomRefine checks: if bomMode='percentage' and !row.percentage, issue error 'Percentage is required'
verify: submission should be blocked
error message 'Percentage is required' should appear on the percentage field of the BOM row

scenarios.name: Non-numeric BOM quantity passes Zod (validation gap)
scenarios.oracle: bomRefine only checks !row.quantity (truthy check). 'abc' is truthy so it passes. But DB column is numeric(12,4) and will reject it.
verify: Zod parse should succeed (current behavior — gap)
payload bom[0].quantity should be 'abc'
API should return a raw DB error
EXPECTED FIX: Zod should validate that quantity is a valid positive number

scenarios.name: Non-numeric BOM percentage passes Zod (validation gap)
scenarios.oracle: bomRefine only checks !row.percentage (truthy check). 'xyz' is truthy so it passes. But DB column is numeric(5,2) and will reject it.
verify: Zod parse should succeed (current behavior — gap)
payload bom[0].percentage should be 'xyz'
API should return a raw DB error
EXPECTED FIX: Zod should validate that percentage is a valid number between 0 and 100

scenarios.name: BOM percentage total warning does NOT block submission
scenarios.oracle: PercentageTotal component shows red text when total != 100%, but this is purely cosmetic — Zod does NOT enforce sum = 100%. Submission proceeds with any total.
verify: red text should display 'Total: 50.0% (should be 100%)'
submission should NOT be blocked
payload should contain bom with percentages summing to 50
API should accept the request

scenarios.name: BOM percentage total at 100% shows neutral text
scenarios.oracle: When Math.abs(total - 100) < 0.01, the total text uses text-muted-foreground (not red) and omits the '(should be 100%)' suffix
actions: add two BOM rows with percentages 60 and 40
verify: text should display 'Total: 100.0%'
text should NOT be red (text-destructive)
text should NOT include '(should be 100%)'

scenarios.name: Duplicate BOM component is rejected by Zod refinement
scenarios.oracle: bomRefine tracks seen componentIds and issues 'Duplicate component' error on second occurrence
actions: select the SAME component for both rows
verify: submission should be blocked
error message 'Duplicate component' should appear on the second row's component field

scenarios.name: BOM row with empty componentId is rejected
scenarios.oracle: bomRowSchema has componentId: z.string().min(1, 'Component is required')
verify: submission should be blocked
error message 'Component is required' should appear on the component combobox

scenarios.name: Self-referencing BOM is rejected by API route
scenarios.oracle: PUT /api/items/[id] checks if bom contains componentId === id and returns 400 with errors.bom message
actions: open edit form for product with id 'X'
add a BOM row with componentId = 'X'
verify: Zod parse should succeed (no self-ref check in Zod)
API should return 400 with { errors: { bom: ['An item cannot reference itself as a component'] } }
form should display the error message

scenarios.name: Whitespace-only SKU normalizes to null
scenarios.oracle: nullableString trims then converts empty to null — '   ' should become null in payload
verify: Zod parse should succeed
payload sku should be null (not empty string, not whitespace)

scenarios.name: Decimal stock value is accepted
scenarios.oracle: stock refine uses Number(v) which accepts decimals — '1.5' is a valid non-negative number
verify: Zod parse should succeed
payload stock should be '1.5'

scenarios.name: Unit dialog rejects size of 0 (POSITIVE_NUMBER_RE requires positive)
scenarios.oracle: POSITIVE_NUMBER_RE is /^\d+\.?\d*$/ — '0' DOES match this regex (starts with digit), so button is enabled. However the field is named 'positive number' — this is a semantic ambiguity: 0 is non-negative but not positive.
verify: POSITIVE_NUMBER_RE.test('0') returns true, so button should be ENABLED
the error text 'Must be a positive number' should NOT appear
NOTE: '0' passes the regex but semantically violates 'positive number' — potential bug

scenarios.name: Unit dialog rejects negative size
scenarios.oracle: POSITIVE_NUMBER_RE is /^\d+\.?\d*$/ — '-1' does NOT match (starts with minus sign), so button is disabled
verify: Create button should be disabled
error text 'Must be a positive number' should appear on size field

scenarios.name: Unit dialog Create button disabled until all fields filled
scenarios.oracle: Button disabled condition: !unitName.trim() || !POSITIVE_NUMBER_RE.test(unitSize.trim()) || !unitUom — all three must be satisfied
verify: Create button should be disabled
entering only name should still leave button disabled
entering name + valid size should still leave button disabled (no UOM)
entering name + valid size + UOM should enable the button

scenarios.name: BOM quantity field is not required when bomMode is 'percentage'
scenarios.oracle: bomRefine only checks quantity when bomMode='quantity' — in percentage mode, null quantity should be accepted
verify: Zod parse should succeed
payload bom[0].quantity should be null
payload bom[0].percentage should have the entered value

scenarios.name: Stock field is optional in edit mode
scenarios.oracle: updateItemSchema has stock as z.string().refine(...).optional() — undefined stock should be accepted
verify: Zod parse should succeed
if stock is undefined in payload, no stock adjustment should occur

scenarios.name: Duplicate SKU within same org is rejected by DB unique constraint
scenarios.oracle: uniqueIndex on (org_id, sku) WHERE sku IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL — Zod does not check uniqueness (cannot), so DB enforces it. API should return a user-friendly error.
verify: first create should succeed
second create should fail with a uniqueness error from the API
error should be surfaced to the user (not a raw Postgres error)

scenarios.name: BOM percentage exceeding numeric(5,2) range causes DB error (Zod gap)
scenarios.oracle: DB column is numeric(5,2) which allows max 999.99. A value like '1000' passes Zod (truthy check only) but overflows the DB column.
verify: Zod parse should succeed (current behavior — gap)
API should return a DB error for numeric overflow
EXPECTED FIX: Zod should validate percentage is between 0 and 100 (or at minimum within numeric(5,2) range)

scenarios.name: Reducing stock below committed quantity is rejected by API
scenarios.oracle: updateItem in DAL throws 'Insufficient stock' when new stock level would go below committed. API catches this and returns 400 with { errors: { stock: [message] } }.
actions: edit item that has committed stock
verify: Zod parse should succeed (no committed-qty check in Zod)
API should return 400 with { errors: { stock: ['Insufficient stock...'] } }
form should display the stock error to the user

scenarios.name: Description accepts both null and undefined (nullableString)
scenarios.oracle: nullableString uses .nullable() — accepts string, null, or undefined. Untouched fields send undefined, cleared fields send null. Both should normalize to null in payload.
actions: do NOT touch description field at all
verify: Zod parse should succeed
payload description should be null (normalized from undefined)
